status: Traced by hand from the registered plan images; plan positions are good to about 1 ft. Riser counts, landing heights and spiral rotation are schematic. Heights are fractions of the floor-to-floor rise, so they follow the building's displayed floor elevations (which are themselves unverified for EER).

sources.title: EER source floor plans
sources.evidence: Pages 1-3 (levels B, 1, 2) show Stair G (wide stair with seat blocks, 1.702), Stair F (two flights with a turning landing), spiral Stair H, and bridge 2.705 crossing the atrium.

sources.title: ENR Texas & Louisiana Best Projects 2018: EERC
sources.evidence: The spiral stair wraps a 45 ft perforated steel tube with diamond-shaped voids that grow toward the roof; the tube was craned in through the roof. Atrium bridge and stair steel is architecturally exposed structural steel.

sources.title: Alcalde: Inside UT's new Engineering Education and Research Center
sources.evidence: Describes white floors in the sunlit lobby, an exposed concrete frame and exposed steel on the skybridge.

stairs.label: Stair G (1.702): lobby seating stair
stairs.note: Rises westward from the basement lobby to Level 1. Seat blocks fill the middle band; ordinary treads run along both sides. Rooms 0.710-0.712B sit beneath its upper (west) part, so it is modeled as a floating stair rather than a solid mass.

stairs.label: Stair F: open stair to Level 2
stairs.note: A long flight climbs north from the top of Stair G to a landing, then turns west to the Level 2 slab.

stairs.label: Stair H: spiral stair around the perforated steel tube
stairs.note: Center and radii are traced from all three plans (agree within 0.6 ft). Rotation direction and step count are schematic.

bridges.label: Bridge 2.705: exposed steel truss bridge across the atrium
bridges.note: Edges follow the reconstructed 2.705 floor surface; truss panel count follows the cross members drawn on the plan. Plan reconstruction extruded the bridge's edge lines into a full-height wall loop (Level 2 wall 57); the viewer hides walls lying entirely inside hide_walls_within and shows the truss rails instead. Exports keep the original wall.
